questions.q: In the first week of typhoid fever, the most useful investigation is:
questions.why: Blood culture is positive in the first week; Widal rises in the second.

questions.q: Anticipatory anxiety with hurriedness, and a craving for sweets which disagree and cause diarrhoea, indicate:
questions.why: Argentum nitricum: hurried, anxious before events, craves sweets, which bring on flatulence and diarrhoea.

questions.q: On a prescription, the 'inscription' is the part that gives:
opts: the name and quantity of the medicine
questions.why: Topic 3, Pharmacy. Superscription (Rx), inscription, subscription (directions to the pharmacist) and signatura (directions to the patient).

questions.q: Irritable bowel with diarrhoea from anticipation before an event, craving for sweets that disagree, and flatulence with loud belching calls for:
questions.why: Anticipatory anxiety, craving for sweets that aggravate, and loud explosive belching are keynotes of Argentum nitricum.

questions.q: Caries of the nasal and palatine bones, with ozaena and a putrid smell from the nose, in a depressed syphilitic patient suggests:
questions.why: Aurum met: caries of nasal and palatine bones, ozaena, putrid odour (Boericke), with profound melancholy.

questions.q: Normal pH of arterial blood is:
The commonest cause of hearing loss in children is:
questions.why: Topic 9, Surgery, ENT, Eye and First Aid. 'Glue ear'.

questions.q: In 'The Genius of Homoeopathy', Stuart Close defined susceptibility as:
opts: the tendency of a disease to spread in a community
the power of a drug to produce symptoms in the healthy
the general quality of the living organism of receiving impressions, the power to react to stimuli
the strength of the medicine after potentisation
questions.why: Close: susceptibility is the capability of the living organism to receive impressions and react to stimuli; it governs both cure and the choice of dose.

questions.q: The 'carrying angle' is formed at the:
questions.why: Topic 5, Anatomy and Physiology. Between the long axes of the arm and forearm in extension.

questions.q: Tonsillitis that begins on the left side and moves to the right, worse after sleep and from hot drinks, with intolerance of anything around the neck, suggests:
questions.why: Topic 7, Practice of Medicine. Lachesis: left to right, worse after sleep. Lycopodium goes right to left.
